caption: The drawing depicts a single heeled shoe rendered in shades of blue, positioned in profile facing left and occupying the lower right portion of the image. The shoe features a slightly pointed toe, decorative stitching, a strap with an angular edge across the instep, and a medium-height, curving heel with a brown sole. Above and to the left of the colored shoe are two lightly sketched outlines of the same shoe, showing the top and bottom views, respectively. The background is a light, beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Woman's Shoe
